subject: Trial credit request — Brightlane accelerator cohort (milestone top-up ask)
messages:
From: Anya Singh <anya@brightlane.ai>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Elaine Park <elaine@seednest.org>
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Trial credit request — Brightlane accelerator cohort (milestone top-up ask)

Hi Rohan / Laura,

Thanks again for the trial credits — Brightlane is in week 6 of the SeedNest accelerator and we've hit the Phase 1 demo milestone ahead of schedule. As discussed during the intro call, we'd like to request a one-time top-up so we can run a burst of integration tests and a small user simulation (estimated 180k tokens).

Quick context: we need to spin up a multi-tenant inference test for our user onboarding flow to replicate expected traffic for the pilot next month. The accelerator is willing to vouch for a partial promotional extension if Redwood can provide credits and a short-term SLA guarantee for the test window (48–72 hours).

Attachments: requested_usage_breakdown.xlsx (breakdown + timeline), demo clip link below.

Can we get confirmation on whether this is possible and any standard terms you need (MSA amendment, confidentiality notes)? Elaine is copied — SeedNest coordinates these program asks.

Thanks,
Anya Singh
Co-founder & CTO, Brightlane AI
anya@brightlane.ai | +1 (415) 555-0198
From: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai <rohan_mehta@redwood.ai>
To: Anya Singh <anya@brightlane.ai>
Cc: marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Date: Tue, 14 Sep 2026 11:03:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credit request — Brightlane accelerator cohort (milestone top-up ask)

Hi Anya — great news on the milestone, congrats to your team.

Short answer: likely yes. We have a couple of conditional asks before we can cut the credit grant:
- Can you confirm the exact token estimate for the burst and the date/time window you want Redwood to reserve capacity for?
- We need the testing to stay within the hosted environment (no on-prem data loads) — if there are any residency constraints please flag them now.
- SeedNest’s vouch + a short co-signed statement that the burst is for validation (not production traffic) will speed approval.

Operationally I can approve up to a $2k equivalent promo (~200k tokens) under the standard accelerator allowance. Anything beyond that requires a promo exception from Growth. If you’re asking for an SLA guarantee for the window, we’ll need a short amendment (one-paragraph) to our trial terms — I can route a templated amendment to speed this.

If that works, please send the preferred window and I’ll loop in Priyom on the exception process if we need to bump the credit cap.

—Rohan
Rohan Mehta
Senior Sales Manager, Redwood Inference
rohan_mehta@redwood.ai

Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 08:27:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credit request — Brightlane accelerator cohort (milestone top-up ask)

Thanks Rohan — details below. Apologies for the late reply, dev sprint overruns.

Requested burst: 2026-09-22 03:00–2026-09-22 11:00 UTC (8 hours).
Estimated usage: 180k tokens total (peak concurrency ~12 requests/sec, avg 120 tokens per request).
Purpose: run multi-tenant onboarding simulation + integration smoke tests for our SDK and session resume.
Residency: all data is synthetic / scrubbed; no PII and no customer data. We’ll run in hosted mode.
SeedNest confirmation: Elaine — the accelerator has approved this ask and will provide a one-line vouch email to you.

Attachments: requested_usage_breakdown.xlsx (already shared), demo clip: https://drive.google.com/file/d/brightlane-demo-clip

Let me know if you need anything else. If Growth needs a short term-amendment for an SLA window, we’re happy to sign.

Best,
Anya
From: Priyom Das <priyom_das@redwood.ai>
To: rohan_mehta@redwood.ai, marissa_cole@redwood.ai, laura_bennett@redwood.ai
Cc: Anya Singh <anya@brightlane.ai>, Elaine Park <elaine@seednest.org>
Date: Wed, 15 Sep 2026 13:11:00 -0700
Subject: Re: Trial credit request — Brightlane accelerator cohort (milestone top-up ask)

Looping in Growth/Programs.

Per our promo policy, we can approve a one-time accelerator top-up up to $2k equivalent without executive sign-off if the program manager (SeedNest) provides explicit sponsorship and the use is non-production — both are satisfied here. I reviewed the usage file — 180k tokens fits within the allowance.

I propose the following:
- Issue a promo grant of 200k tokens (safety buffer) to Brightlane, valid for 72 hours starting at the requested UTC start time.
- Add a one-paragraph trial amendment specifying the test window and that Redwood will treat traffic as non-production; no change to broader SLA.
- Require the accelerator sponsorship email to be attached to the deal record (Elaine, can you reply with that line?).

I’ll prepare the amendment PDF (redwood-term-amendment-v1.pdf) — Marissa, can you review for standard legal language? Once Marissa signs off I’ll schedule the grant and post the DocuSign link for Anya.

—Priyom
Priyom Das
Program Operations, Redwood Inference

2) Amendment: redwood-term-amendment-v1.pdf (attached) — one-paragraph amendment describing the reserved test window and non-production clause. Please sign via DocuSign: https://www.docusign.com/embedded-sign/abc123.

Anya, after you sign we’ll queue the token grant and an engineer from our SRE team will monitor the window. Thanks and congrats again — looking forward to the demo.

—Rohan
